title: ever LUCIE|Off-Shoulder Sweetheart Double Layer Pleated Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This floor-length A-line pleated evening dress features a double layer of sheer material on top of a push-up sweetheart neckline and tiered skirt. A cinched bodice and delicate off-shoulder sleeves give this vintage-inspired dress a princess style, perfect for a date, banquet, wedding, or bridesmaid dress.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.

Length: Floor length.

Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.

Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.

Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.

Fabric: The garment comprises tulle.

Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
